# hToAA_4b_ma60

**AIDA-Scout S4 (h -> a a, a -> b bbar)** -- generated by `make_signal_cards.py`.

A 125 GeV Higgs produced by gluon fusion decays to a pair of light pseudoscalars of mass 60 GeV, each decaying to b bbar. The final state is four b bbar objects sharing 125 GeV, so each carries roughly 31 GeV before any further decay.

## Configuration

* Hard process: `HiggsSM:gg2H`, m_h = 125 GeV
* `25:addChannel -> 36 36`, all SM Higgs decays closed
* m_a = 60 GeV, `36:addChannel -> 5 -5`, prompt (`tau0 = 0`)
* No 2HDM+S UFO is required -- this is entirely a decay-table configuration, which is why it runs on the pythia branch
* Reference cross section sigma(gg->h) = **28.07 pb** (Pythia LO, no k-factor); rescale by your assumed BR(h->aa) -- see the normalisation warning shared with the S1 points

## Why it evades (or does not evade) the Phase-2 L1 menu

| Seed | Threshold | Fires? |
|---|---|---|
| PuppiHT | 450 (constituents pT > 30) | no |
| SinglePuppiJet | 230 | no |
| QuadJet | 400,70,55,40,40 | no |
| DoubleTkMuon (BPH) | 2,2, abs(eta)<1.5, dR<1.4, OS, dz<1cm | no |
| DoubleTkMuon (central) | 4,4 | no |
| DoubleTkElectron | 25,12 | no |
| DoubleTkIsoPhoton | 22,12 | no |
| DoublePuppiTau | 52,52 | no |
| PuppiETmiss | 200 | no |


## Note

m_a must clear 2 m_b ~ 9.4 GeV for this mode, which is why the mass points start at 15 GeV rather than the 5 GeV used for the tau mode. The four b jets are soft and, at the lower masses, the two b jets from one `a` merge into a single reconstructed jet.

## Running

```bash
apptainer exec --bind $simdir \
  /cvmfs/unpacked.cern.ch/registry.hub.docker.com/jmduarte/mapyde:latest \
  sh $simdir/run.sh hToAA_4b_ma60 <nevents> <seed> $simdir False
```

This point uses the **pythia** branch of `run.sh`.
